The Signed Agreement remains unchanged and takes precedence. # Annexure B \| Commercial Structure & Pricing ## Puretronics Wire & Cable Demand Engine Build + Monthly Demand Activation Retainer **Prepared for:** Puretronics India Private Limited **Prepared by:** Stratagem Olympus LLP **Date:** 9 July 2026 --- ## Signed Agreement Alignment Note This Annexure B is aligned to the signed Services Agreement dated **9 July 2026**. The Services Agreement is the source of truth for commercial terms, payment terms, scope-control language, exclusions, client responsibilities, performance language, and termination provisions. The signed pilot project runs from **15 July 2026 to 31 December 2027**. The one-time build period is **July-August 2026**. The monthly activation retainer period is **September 2026 to December 2027**. No changes are to be made to the signed Services Agreement through this Annexure B. Any difference between this page and the signed Services Agreement must be resolved in favour of the signed Services Agreement. --- # 1. Signed Commercial Structure
Commercial Component Signed Structure Period Value Excluding Taxes
One-Time Custom Funnel Build Fixed one-time build fee July-August 2026 INR 5,50,000
Monthly Demand Activation Retainer Fixed monthly retainer September 2026 to December 2027 INR 65,000/month for 16 months
Total Monthly Retainer Value 16 committed monthly retainers September 2026 to December 2027 INR 10,40,000
Total Project Value One-time build plus monthly retainers 15 July 2026 to 31 December 2027 INR 15,90,000
The signed commercial path is **One-Time Custom Funnel Build + 16-month Monthly Demand Activation Retainer**. Proposal-stage pricing menus, optional enhanced versions, and plan ladders are not part of the active signed commercial structure unless separately approved in writing by both parties. --- # 2. Part I: One-Time Custom Funnel Build ## Signed Fee **INR 5,50,000 one-time**, excluding applicable taxes. ## Signed Build Period **July-August 2026**. ## Build Objective The one-time build creates the Puretronics Wire & Cable Demand Engine for the signed pilot scope. It is intended to turn Puretronics' covered Wire & Cable product universe into a structured, technically credible, commercially usable funnel system. ## Build Scope
Build Area Signed Treatment
Wire & Cable industry landing page Included as the primary pilot entry point
Buyer navigation Find by Problem, Find by Production Stage, and Find by Product Family
Solution blocks Inline Measurement & Dimensional Control; Inline Spark Testing & Insulation Fault Detection; Cable Testing & Validation; Process Equipment & Line Auxiliaries; Tension, Braking & Line Control
Technical proof layer Foundation proof assets, technical-library structure, datasheet/request support, and evaluation-support content
Requirement capture Adaptive requirement form and routing logic for relevant enquiries
Service/support route Included to separate support intent from new commercial demand
Management visibility Basic dashboard/reporting structure for funnel and enquiry visibility
The build is limited to the covered Wire & Cable products and variants listed in the signed Services Agreement Annexure A. --- # 3. Covered Product Scope The active pilot scope is limited to the following Wire & Cable products and variants from the signed Services Agreement Annexure A.
Product Platform Covered Products / Variants
Laser Diameter Measurement Platform Laser Diameter Gauge / LASER 2008; LASER 2008B
LASER 2000 Series Scan Micrometers LASER-2060; LASER-2012; LASER-2030
LASER-H Series LASER-2010H; LASER-2020H; LASER-2030H
Laser Measurement Accessories HMI display, PC software, guide rollers, auto-correction pot, stands, rotating stands, extra display, data logger, controller, motorised controller, where applicable; support items only
Wire Tension Indicator WTI-90-40; WTI-100-40
Spark Testing Platform Live Spark Tester; Acute Spark Tester; DC Spark Tester
Spark Tester Accessories / Fault Intelligence Stage 1 Fault Interface; Stage 2 Data Logging & Graphics; Stage 3 Inline Marking System; Spark Tester Sensitivity Calibrator; UL electrode option where applicable; support items only
HV Tester Platform AC HV Tester; DC HV Tester
Fire Resistance Cable Testing System Included
Inline Induction Wire Preheater 1000 m/min; 1500 m/min; 2000 m/min variants
LSP Static Powder Applicator LSP-G1; LSP-G2
Butt Welding Machine Copper and aluminium stranded wire / solid conductor applications
LTC-PRO Web Tension Controller Included
Loadcells / Tension Transducers AR-85 Series; AR-118 Series; AR-125 Series; AR-ST Series; LC-AR-60 Series; LC-AR-HD Series
Loadcell Accessories / Integration Items Loadcell Amplifier LA-175 / LXR; small round bracket; big round bracket; connecting cable; L type bracket for AR-85; bearing block; support items only
Pneumatic Brake AX-250; AX-400; AX-500
Accessory items are support items only. Their inclusion does not imply separate standalone pages, campaigns, forms, automations, or assets unless separately approved in writing. --- # 4. Part II: Monthly Demand Activation Retainer ## Signed Monthly Retainer **INR 65,000 per month**, excluding applicable taxes. ## Signed Retainer Period **September 2026 to December 2027**, for a committed duration of **16 months**. ## Monthly Scope
Activation Area Signed Monthly Output / Treatment
Technical content production 4 technical thought-leadership/document assets per month
Company Page distribution 8 Company Page distribution posts/assets per month
Leadership or sales-profile LinkedIn distribution 8 leadership or sales-profile LinkedIn posts/assets per month
Planning and reporting Monthly content planning, reporting, and guidance
LinkedIn outreach Outreach to 300 prospects per month
LinkedIn sequence 1 connection request plus 2 follow-ups
LinkedIn management Monthly optimization and reporting; assisted inbox management
Cold email outreach Up to 20,000 campaign email sends per month
Cold email sequence Core sequence setup
Reply handling Basic reply triage
Cold email optimization Monthly optimization and reporting
Lead handoff CSV/manual lead handoff
Additional cold email sends beyond 20,000 campaign email sends per month are charged at **INR 0.50 per additional email**, subject to prior written approval. --- # 5. Monthly Scope Conditions Monthly outputs are subject to timely Client inputs, approvals, account access, platform limits, data availability, and campaign feasibility. Outreach volume may be paced or adjusted to protect account health, deliverability, platform compliance, and campaign quality. Missed output caused by Client-side delay does not automatically carry forward unless agreed in writing. Additional languages may be incorporated on a reasonable best-efforts basis where commercially appropriate, without a committed volume or additional fee obligation. Named-account targeting is a targeting discipline used within the signed monthly retainer, not a separately priced module. Technical content, LinkedIn outreach, and cold email activation are covered through the signed monthly retainer. Search-led discovery and direct visits may be supported as destination behavior, but SEO is excluded unless separately scoped. --- # 6. Payment Terms ## One-Time Build Payment Schedule
Milestone Amount Payment Timing
Advance payment INR 3,30,000 Payable upon execution of the signed Services Agreement
Balance payment INR 2,20,000 Payable by 31 August 2026, Go-Live, or full completion of the one-time build, whichever occurs earlier
If completion is delayed due to Client-side dependencies, including approvals, product information, technical validation, access, or feedback, the balance payment remains payable by 31 August 2026. The signed Services Agreement governs the full completion and Client-delay nuance. ## Monthly Retainer Payment Schedule
Term Signed Treatment
Monthly retainer INR 65,000/month
Billing period September 2026 to December 2027
Payment window 15th to 20th day of every month for the same month
Taxes GST and applicable taxes are extra
Late payment 15-day grace period applies; service suspension may follow as per the signed agreement
--- # 7. Third-Party Tools and Client-Borne Costs Third-party software/tool costs required by Stratagem Olympus LLP to deliver the signed services are included in the service fees. The following items are excluded and are borne by Puretronics unless separately agreed in writing: - Domain procurement - Mailbox procurement - Prospect database procurement - Paid databases - LinkedIn Sales Navigator - List building - Data enrichment - Data verification - Any other external procurement cost not expressly included in the signed Services Agreement --- # 8. Exclusions The following are excluded from the signed scope unless separately approved in writing: - Products not listed in signed Services Agreement Annexure A - Product categories outside the Wire & Cable pilot scope - Additional standalone product pages - Additional campaigns - Paid advertising and media buying - SEO - Domain procurement and mailbox procurement - Prospect database costs, list building, data enrichment, and verification - Photography, videography, travel, printing, and trade show support - Sales closure responsibility - Legal, regulatory, or region-specific data-governance advisory - Anything not expressly included in the signed Services Agreement --- # 9. Client Responsibilities and Approvals Puretronics is responsible for validating product, technical, performance, compliance, specification, and material accuracy. Puretronics must provide consolidated feedback within **7 business days** where applicable. The Service Provider will give the Client an approval timeline of **7 days** for relevant approvals. Puretronics is responsible for providing required inputs, technical information, account access, product validation, brand assets, stakeholder availability, and approvals needed to deliver the agreed scope. --- # 10. Performance Language The signed engagement carries a dialogue initiation benchmark of approximately **15% to 20%** of total prospects outreached over a reasonable campaign period. This benchmark is non-binding. It is not a guarantee of leads, enquiries, sales, revenue, conversions, refunds, penalties, or payment relief. --- # 11. Termination and Scope Change Handling The monthly demand activation retainer is committed from **September 2026 to December 2027**. Early termination for convenience, where applicable under the signed Services Agreement, attracts a charge equal to two months' retainer: **INR 1,30,000**, plus any other dues payable under the signed agreement. Any scope beyond the signed Wire & Cable pilot, including additional standalone pages, additional campaigns, product selectors, calculators, configurators, export-market expansion, partner/OEM expansion, multilingual expansion, SEO, paid advertising, or additional product categories, requires separate written approval. --- # 12. Final Commercial Alignment Statement This Annexure B reflects the signed commercial structure for Puretronics: **INR 5,50,000 one-time build fee + INR 65,000/month demand activation retainer for 16 months**, for a total project value of **INR 15,90,000 excluding taxes**. The signed Services Agreement dated **9 July 2026** remains the locked source of truth. "}
